description: Plugin source host queries, candidates and release hints. File selectors apply to torrents (provider file list) and NZBs (document order). See docs/plugin-kinds.md.

query.description: Search text for indexer_search. May be omitted or empty when category is set to fetch the newest up to 100 recent releases.

category.description: Comma-separated Newznab category IDs (1000–8999) or standard family names. Applied to generic indexer_search; when query is empty, requests recent releases.

profile.description: Quality profile name used to score video release names on indexer_search; omit or leave empty to use the owner's default profile.

torrentUrl.description: Torrent download or details page link for torrent indexers that do not supply an infoHash or magnet.

nzbUrl.description: Usenet NZB download link for usenet_check when not passing a full candidate.

candidate.description: A candidate from indexer_search handed back for release_files or usenet_check, so an NZB or torrent link is resolved through its originating indexer.

available.description: True when all sampled NZB articles were confirmed available and no playback failure is recorded for this NZB.

checked.description: Number of sampled articles evaluated (bounded by Ether's per-check sample cap).

missing.description: Number of sampled or playback-observed articles confirmed missing.

cached.description: True when the verdict was served from Ether's bounded per-NZB cache (including a recorded playback failure) without running a fresh NNTP check.

playbackFailed.description: True when a real playback attempt against this NZB failed with an article or release error.

reason.description: Short diagnostic code when available is false (e.g. articles_missing, segment_absent_from_nzb, playback_article_missing, playback_article_corrupt, playback_release_rejected).

checkedAt.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when this verdict or playback failure was recorded.

index.description: Zero-based non-directory member index inside the archive.

path.description: Inner member path inside the archive; hand back as release.fileHint (or container.member) to open that exact member.

stored.description: True when the member is stored uncompressed and can stream directly by byte range.

index.description: Position Ether's file selection counts: provider file-list order for torrents, NZB document order for Usenet.

size.description: Decoded file size in bytes (exact when known from torrent/debrid, PAR2, or yEnc headers; segment-derived estimate when sizeApproximate is true).

sizeApproximate.description: True when size is a segment-derived decoded estimate rather than an exact byte count.

members.description: Non-directory files inside this archive (RAR, 7z, ZIP), populated on the first volume of readable Usenet archives.

disc.description: Optional one-based disc number for multi-disc releases.

number.description: One-based track number; matched first alongside disc.

title.description: Optional track title used to disambiguate track-number ties or match by normalised title tokens when track numbers are absent.

id.description: Configured debrid service ID in Ether.

name.description: Display name for the debrid service (the owner's configured account name, or the provider label such as TorBox or Real-Debrid).

torrentUrl.description: Key-less torrent download or details page link for torrent indexers (same-origin indexer credentials are stripped and re-attached by Ether at fetch time when handed back with indexerId); torrent candidates never populate nzbUrl.

nzbUrl.description: Key-less Usenet NZB download link populated only for Usenet candidates. Same-origin indexer API keys and secrets are stripped so candidates are safe to cache in plugin storage; Ether re-attaches credentials on same-origin fetches when handed back with indexerId.

fileIndex.description: Zero-based index in the provider torrent file list. Omit for automatic video selection.

cachedBy.description: Configured debrid services holding this torrent in Ether's acquisition priority order (or, on debrid_acquire, the service that served it). Omitted when uncached.

score.description: Owner quality-profile score for video release names on indexer_search; omitted on non-video candidates.

resolution.description: Parsed vertical resolution (e.g. 2160, 1080) for video release names; omitted on non-video candidates.

source.description: Parsed video source (e.g. remux, bluray, webdl, webrip, hdtv) for video release names; omitted on non-video candidates.

codec.description: Parsed video codec (e.g. av1, hevc, h264) for video release names; omitted on non-video candidates.

files.description: Files inside this release; populated only by a release_files query.

usenetCheck.description: Sampled Usenet article availability verdict and any recorded playback failure; populated only by a usenet_check query.

fileIndex.description: Zero-based index in the provider torrent file list, or NZB document order for Usenet. Omit for automatic video selection.

file.description: Exact torrent path or unambiguous basename (either protocol); if combined with fileIndex both must match.

fileHint.description: Exact archive member path or unique basename when composing a release with container extraction.

track.description: Structured audio track hint ({disc?, number?, title?}) matched against release files or archive members by disc/track number first, then normalised title tokens, failing on ambiguity.

cachedOnly.description: Require an already-cached debrid copy even when the owner turned "Cached torrents only" off. Omit or set false to follow the owner's debrid setting (queueing an uncached download and answering preparing / 503 Retry-After until ready when cached-only is off).
